Report D4-PHONE-TRANSFER with your device, browser and Android version and what you actually saw, including the receiving app and the Conservazione dei dati answer.

Supabase's built-in sender only delivers to the addresses of your Supabase team (your own account email) and a few emails an hour: if your test accounts use other addresses, add a user with your own address in Authentication > Users > Add user. Turn on airplane mode, add a student, close the app completely, reopen it: Impostazioni should show your account and 'In attesa di connessione: 1 modifica da inviare'. Turn airplane mode off and check it reaches Copia online aggiornata without reopening.

With airplane mode on again, change a student, then tap Esci: read the question (it should mention 1 change not yet online), tap Resta collegato, then Esci and Esci. The course must stay on the phone. Optionally the next morning, with airplane mode on, open the app and note what Impostazioni says.

items.title: Update to 0.5.3: the PC finishes its restore and follows the phone
instructions: Your offline-day steps already passed on 0.5.2. This recheck covers the PC and takes a few minutes.

On the PC, close every tab of the test address and open it again. If Nuova versione disponibile appears, tap Aggiorna. The stuck restore should finish by itself and the app should open on your course, with Versione 0.5.3 in Impostazioni. If it is still stuck after a minute, stop and report that.
On the phone, in Chrome (do not reinstall), switch away and back until Nuova versione disponibile appears, tap Aggiorna, and check Impostazioni shows Versione 0.5.3 and Copia online aggiornata.
Change a note on the phone. On the PC, leave that screen and open it again: the change should be there. An open screen does not refresh by itself.
Change a note on the PC and check the same on the phone.

Do not use Azzera tutti i dati locali or Elimina il corso while signed in: they also erase the online copy (that is checked later, in B6-PHONE-ERASE). Do not create a course on a second device while the first is offline or already has one: until B7 that locks every device of the account.
Report B4-PHONE-UPLOADS with what you saw at each step.
items.expected: 0.5.3 updates in place on both devices and keeps the backup. The PC leaves the stuck restore and opens on your course. An edit on either device reaches the other after its screen is left and reopened. Only your actual observations can pass this check.

result.summary: Offline day on 0.5.1: saving as fast as usual with about 150 changes waiting. Airplane mode off: just under 10 s before sending started, about 45 s to send them all, the count decreasing at a steady rate. Throughout and after, Impostazioni showed 'Ora senza connessione' with the warning icon, ending on 'Tutto inviato. Ora senza connessione', although the phone was online and everything was sent; closing and reopening the app showed 'Copia online aggiornata'. Only one copy of the app was open.

Phone on 0.5.2: update in place fine; a few hours offline with about 200 changes; airplane mode off sent them too fast to count and the status reached Copia online aggiornata by itself; Ora senza connessione went away; a later 40-change comandate recompute shows it for under a second. Step 5 failed on the PC: a new course in desktop Chrome, sign-in, replace with the online copy, and the app stays on Ripristino del corso dal backup online, also after a refresh. Reproduced: the desktop shared sync worker never starts (DataCloneError on the database options).

items.title: Erase your course on the phone, once offline, and see it gone from the backup
instructions: Only after B4-PHONE-UPLOADS and B5-PHONE-RESTORE are reported: they need the course on the backup. Use invented data only. These steps erase your test course for good; save a course file first if you want to keep it.

Start with both devices signed in, on 0.5.3 and showing the same course. On the phone: Impostazioni, Elimina il corso e inizia un nuovo corso. Read the question: it should say the course also goes from the backup online, and state what the provider's backups keep and for how long. Tick Ho capito and tap Elimina tutto.
The phone reopens on Crea il corso. On the PC, reload the test address: the erased course should be gone and it should wait for the account's course, not show the old one.
On the phone, create a different invented course with one student. Wait for Copia online aggiornata. Reload the PC: it should download and open this new course.

Now put the phone in airplane mode. Impostazioni, Elimina il corso e inizia un nuovo corso: this time the question should say appena c'è connessione. Confirm. The phone reopens on Crea il corso without signal.
Before reconnecting, reload the PC: the course is still there, because the phone has not been able to tell the backup yet.
Turn airplane mode off and keep the app open on the phone for a minute. Reload the PC: the course should be gone. Reload it again a minute later: it should not come back.

Optional: on the phone, create one more invented course, wait for Copia online aggiornata, then Impostazioni, Azzera tutti i dati locali. Its question should warn that the course also leaves the backup and that without signal nothing is reset. Confirm with signal and check the PC loses it too.
Report B6-PHONE-ERASE with what you saw at each step, and which you skipped.
items.expected: Erasing the course on the phone erases it from the backup, also when the erase was made offline and the phone reconnected later; the erased course never comes back. Only your actual observations can pass this check.

items.title: Let Vento fetch forecasts before sign-in
instructions: This cycle's rule is that nothing connects before sign-in. Vento breaks it on purpose: once you open it, the phone asks Open-Meteo and LaMMA for forecasts, and keeps asking by itself while it stays open (when you come back to it, when signal returns, after a reload).

They receive the phone's internet address, the time and the fixed sea points of the area, which show whether it is a Derive or a Cabinati course. Never a name, a course or a student. Home never connects: it shows the last forecast downloaded.
Tell me 'Vento may connect' to accept. Or say what you want instead, for example only after sign-in, or only on a tap each time.
items.expected: With a yes, the rule is amended in the plan, 03 and DEPLOY.md together, and WX1 starts after B7's handoff. With another answer, Vento's design changes before it starts.

items.title: Tell LaMMA about the use, and check Open-Meteo's terms
instructions: LaMMA's disclaimer asks that information on the use of its products be sent to it. Write to info@lamma.toscana.it: CVC Helper, a tool for the Caprera sailing centre's instructors, shows LaMMA's Bocche di Bonifacio wind and wave maps unaltered, with credit and a link. You may also ask whether they could offer a point series or allow a browser to read their data for Caprera.

Open-Meteo's free service is for non-commercial use under 10,000 calls a day (https://open-meteo.com/en/terms). Decide whether the centre's use qualifies, and whether the Home line, which quotes their data, needs their credit too. If unsure, ask them.
Tell me what you sent and what you decided. I do not write to either on your behalf.
items.expected: Both providers' terms are respected before Vento reaches anyone but you.
